The Space

Cascais, moments from the sea

A fully furnished studio in Bicesse, on the quieter side of the Cascais peninsula — close enough to the ocean that you can feel it, far enough from the crowds to rest properly. The apartment is self-contained and ready: kitchen, bathroom, comfortable bed, everything you need to make a few nights feel like home.

Whether you are here to explore Lisbon, walk the coastal trails, or simply slow down for a long weekend, this is a good place to return to at the end of the day. We are available throughout your stay and can help with directions, recommendations, or anything you need.
